name: Tanium — Managed Assets
description: Pull managed endpoint inventory from Tanium including patch compliance status

steps.instruction: Log into the Tanium console as an administrator
Navigate to Administration → Permissions → API Tokens
Generate a new read-only API token. Copy the token value.

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Tanium. Check your API token and instance URL.

transform.expr: {'ip': record.get('ip_address', ''), 'hostname': record.get('computer_name', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('computer_name', ''), 'device_id': record.get('id', ''), 'display_name': record.get('computer_name') or record.get('ip_address', '')}

{'domain': record.get('domain', ''), 'chassis_type': record.get('chassis_type', ''), 'is_virtual': record.get('is_virtual', ''), 'cpu_count': record.get('cpu_count', ''), 'total_physical_memory': record.get('total_physical_memory', ''), 'last_reboot_time': record.get('last_reboot_time', ''), 'agent_version': record.get('tanium_client_version', ''), 'compliance_status': record.get('patch_compliance_percentage', ''), 'managed_patch_count': record.get('managed_patch_count', ''), 'installed_patch_count': record.get('installed_patch_count', '')}
